slot.brief: Evaluate statements on NH3, PH3, AsH3 regarding thermal stability, reducing character and bond angle trends down the group; pick the correct combination.

stem: Consider the following statements about Group 15 hydrides: I. Thermal stability follows $\text{NH}_3>\text{PH}_3>\text{AsH}_3$. II. Reducing character follows $\text{NH}_3>\text{PH}_3>\text{AsH}_3$. III. Bond angle follows $\text{NH}_3>\text{PH}_3>\text{AsH}_3$. Which statements are correct?

verdicts.working: Thermal stability decreases down the group, so I is true. Reducing character increases down the group, so II is false. Bond angle decreases from NH₃ to AsH₃, so III is true.

working:
Thermal stability decreases down the group: $\text{NH}_3>\text{PH}_3>\text{AsH}_3$. Reducing character increases down the group, so II is false. Bond angle decreases down the group: $\text{NH}_3>\text{PH}_3>\text{AsH}_3$. Hence I and III only.

Independent check: Thermal stability decreases down the group, so I is true. Reducing character increases down the group, so II is false. Bond angle decreases from NH₃ to AsH₃, so III is true.
solution: Thermal stability decreases down Group 15, so $\text{NH}_3>\text{PH}_3>\text{AsH}_3$; I is true. Reducing character increases down the group, making II false, while bond angle decreases down the group, so III is true. Hence, I and III only.
